title: The application of implant technology for cybernetic systems
rationale: Warwick et al. 2003 [11] (research-project.md line 303). Nerve-implant link to external hardware; the function (control of a machine through an implant) is not in references/abilities.md and the research document excludes links that run through implanted or external hardware to a machine or another person (line 17). Not a review, so E7 does not fire; E1-E4 do not apply before E5.

title: Walking naturally after spinal cord injury using a brain-spine interface
rationale: Lorach et al. 2023 [13] (line 305). Brain-spine interface: the change runs through implanted hardware to a stimulator; function not in references/abilities.md and excluded by the research document's scope (line 17). Not a review (single-participant device study).

title: A direct brain-to-brain interface in humans
rationale: Rao et al. 2014 [14] (line 306). Hardware link between two people (EEG to TMS); function not in references/abilities.md; excluded by the research document's scope (line 17). Not a review.

title: BrainNet: a multi-person brain-to-brain interface for direct collaboration between brains
rationale: Jiang et al. 2019 [15] (line 307). Hardware-mediated multi-person interface; function not in references/abilities.md; excluded by the research document's scope (line 17). Not a review.

title: Does psi exist? Lack of replication of an anomalous process of information transfer
rationale: Milton & Wiseman 1999 [16] (line 308). A meta-analysis pooling 30 ganzfeld studies (research-project.md line 146): E7 is tested first and stops the sequence, so E5 (unaided mind-to-mind transfer is not an ability) must NOT be recorded. Tests the E7-first rule.

title: The mechanism of placebo analgesia
rationale: Levine, Gordon & Fields 1978 [77] (line 369). Placebo analgesia given by others: no deliberate attempt by the person to change a bodily function; the research document excludes effects the person does not initiate (line 17). Not a review (primary clinical experiment).

title: Endogenous opiates and the placebo effect: a meta-analytic review
rationale: Sauro & Greenberg 2005 [78] (line 370). Meta-analytic review: E7 is tested first and stops the sequence, so E2 (placebo, no deliberate attempt) must NOT be recorded. Tests the E7-first rule.

title: Behavioral conditioning of immunosuppression is possible in humans
rationale: Goebel et al. 2002 [80] (line 372). Classically conditioned immune response: no deliberate attempt by the person (line 17 excludes classically conditioned immune responses). Immune-conditioning record, not an A09 immune-challenge (endotoxin) study; screened from the record text only. Not a review.

title: Placebo effects on the immune response in humans: the role of learning and expectation
rationale: Albring et al. 2012 [81] (line 373). Placebo/learned immune response given by others: no deliberate attempt by the person (line 17). Immune-conditioning record, not an A09 endotoxin-challenge study. Not a review.

title: Learned immunosuppressive placebo responses in renal transplant patients
rationale: Kirchhof et al. 2018 [82] (line 374). Learned (conditioned) placebo response in patients: no deliberate attempt by the person (line 17). Immune-conditioning record, not an A09 endotoxin-challenge study. Not a review.
